content.summary: The risk shared by all ten companies is cybersecurity breach of information systems, which every company in the group discloses. The most widely shared specific risk linking autos and semis is workforce labor strikes and work stoppages, disclosed by seven companies including NXPI (semis) and GM, Ford and Tesla (autos). The excerpts support these two risks only for the companies quoted, so the claims below cover a sample rather than all disclosing companies.

claims.quote: Our computer systems and networks are subject to attempted security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, which, if successful, could adversely impact our business.

Breaches, disruptions or other incidents relating to our information technology systems or the systems of our customers, suppliers and other third parties could be caused by factors such as computer viruses, ransomware, malware

Disruptions or breaches of our information technology systems could irreparably damage our reputation and our business, expose us to liability and materially adversely affect our results of operations.

claims.risk: Cyberattacks on IT and third-party systems
claims.quote: IT systems are vulnerable to disruptions, including those resulting from natural disasters, cyber-attacks or failures in third-party provided services.

We and our third-party providers regularly experience cyberattacks and security incidents, such as phishing attacks, and we expect cyberattacks and incidents to continue in varying degrees, including due to the rapid evolution and adoption of AI.
if our unionized employees were to engage in a strike or other work stoppage, our business and operating results could be materially harmed.
Any work stoppages or strikes organized by such unions could delay the manufacture and sale of our products and may harm our business and operating results.
As a result, we may be subject to an increased risk of strikes, work stoppages, or other types of conflicts with labor unions and employees.

A work stoppage or other limitation on production has occurred, and could in the future occur, at Ford’s facilities, at a facility in its supply chain, or at one of its logistics providers for any number of reasons
A significant labor dispute involving us or one or more of our customers or suppliers or that could otherwise affect our operations could adversely affect our financial performance.

claims.risk: Strike or work disruption by employees
claims.quote: A strike or other form of significant work disruption by our employees would likely have an adverse effect on our ability to operate our business.
